name: Open the lab with a measurable water sample
description: Verifies the initial 250 mL beaker and its sample water volume are represented in the scene inventory.
steps: Open the Chemistry Beaker Lab
Wait for the 3D scene to initialize
Inspect the first Scene inventory item
expected: The scene status reads READY and the 250 mL B001 beaker appears with 150 mL water.

name: Edit a beaker water volume within its capacity
description: Verifies a selected beaker accepts an explicit water quantity and reflects the same value in its inventory record.
steps: Open View B001 specifications from Scene inventory
Set Water volume to 225 mL
Click Set volume
Check the liquid volume label and Scene inventory
expected: The selected 250 mL beaker reports 225 mL of water and its inventory text updates to the same quantity.

name: Grab, rotate, lift and safely cancel a beaker
description: Verifies the manipulation workflow enters rotation and lift modes and Escape restores the beaker to its original safe transform.
steps: Click and drag the 250 mL beaker in the 3D stage
Press R and drag to change its orientation
Press Shift to activate automatic lifting
Verify the handling state reports the lifted state
Press Escape to cancel the manipulation
expected: The beaker can be grabbed and reoriented, the lift state activates, Escape restores its starting position and orientation, and normal camera controls are available again.

name: Place a second beaker with the existing ghost preview
description: Verifies the latest handling changes retain the live 3D placement preview and collision guardrails.
steps: Choose 500 mL in the Beaker capacity selector
Click Pick & Place Beaker
Move the ghost over an empty visible area of the lab until it is cyan
Confirm placement with a click
Verify the new beaker appears in Scene inventory
expected: The temporary ghost is shown before confirmation, the valid location is cyan, and one permanent 500 mL beaker is added after the valid click.

name: Preserve inventory, recycle and mobile handling controls
description: Verifies the compact touch controls remain available during handling and that the inventory recycle workflow is retained.
steps: Open the lab at a mobile viewport
Touch and hold a visible beaker in the 3D stage
Use the Rotate and Lift controls in the handling toolbar
Press and release Hold to pour
Use Cancel to return the beaker safely
Remove a beaker from Scene inventory, open Recycle Bin, and restore it
expected: The mobile handling toolbar provides the same controls, releasing Hold to pour stops transfer requests, Cancel ends manipulation safely, and a removed beaker can be restored.
